title: Choose a result
summary: T-SQL: Choose a result. Try score 3. Try a small example and check what happens.
introduction: CASE returns a value from the first matching branch. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Connect to a practice SQL Server database with SSMS or sqlcmd. Run one example at a time. Results below show cell values or PRINT text without grid headers.

blocks.title: Choose a result
blocks.code:
DECLARE @score int = 8;
SELECT CASE WHEN @score >= 5 THEN 'Pass' ELSE 'Try again' END AS message;

blocks.text: The first CASE condition is true for 8. It returns Pass.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: CASE ends with END; it is an expression, not an IF block.
